basic_info.description:
Located on the coveted corner of 40th and Anza, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of coastal charm and city convenience. Flooded with natural light, the home features a formal dining room and an inviting living room with a fireplace, ideal for gatherings. A den provides the perfect space for remote work, a study, or a cozy retreat.

Enjoy a partial ocean view from the top floor bedroom, while the large backyard provides ample space for relaxation, entertaining, and gardening. A one-car garage adds convenience. The home's prime location places you just a short stroll from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Lands End - perfect for outdoor enthusiasts. You'll also be walking distance to restaurants, Balboa theater, retail shops, markets, and schools. 

With easy access to public transportation, commuting is a breeze.

Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a stunning home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!
